approval_note: All six 3072x2048 extension PNGs passed visual-auditor agent inspection (AGENT_PASS). Final visual approval belongs exclusively to the user (never claimed as USER_APPROVED).

integration_architecture.pan_zoom_constraint: FTB Quests native pan/zoom intentionally extends past chapter content bounds; these finite 3072x2048 PNGs cover the active chapter canvas (~36x24 to 48x32 quest units) and must not be described as infinite pan coverage.

background_extension_layer.notes: Quiet full-page pixel-art extension with zero duplicated title emblem. The central >85% field is locked to the exact outer border RGB of the corresponding original JPG.

original_identity_panel_layer.source_preservation: Retained byte-for-byte from supplied original JPG as a separate compact chapter image layer above the background extension.
original_identity_panel_layer.blend_method: Exact outer-border RGB match between the original JPG rectangle and the extension PNG quiet central field; no cutout, blur, fake pixelation, or black rectangle.

native_layout_art_direction.hard_rule: Never invent gameplay dependency edges; all layouts below position existing quest nodes spatially without adding synthetic prerequisite lines.

biomes.title_placement: Compact original biomes.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: -7.5), ~12.0x6.7 quest units.
biomes.node_layout: Arrange independent biome discovery nodes in an organic multi-lobe constellation arc across y: -2.0 to +8.5, x: -15.0 to +15.0 over the quiet #0f1522 field, grouped by temperature/elevation (icy/alpine left, temperate/lush center-left, arid/mesa center-right, aquatic/deep-cave right above the cyan basin).

companions.title_placement: Compact original companions.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: -6.5), ~12.0x9.0 quest units on the #8e8b92 field.
companions.node_layout: Arrange tameable/companion creature nodes along three gentle diverging delta channels flowing downward and outward from y: -1.0 to +8.0 toward the bottom-left and bottom-right pebble/ripple corners, keeping >=2.0 quest units between channels.

home.title_placement: Compact original home.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: -7.5), ~12.0x6.7 quest units on the #1d1f2b field.
home.node_layout: Group furniture, lighting, storage, and decorative block quests into compact 1-to-3-node gallery islands spaced on a calm staggered grid (x: -14.0 to +14.0, y: -2.0 to +7.5) with generous 2.5-to-3.5-unit breathing room between islands above the bottom brick/ivy wainscot.

food.title_placement: Compact original food.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: -7.5), ~12.0x6.7 quest units on the #0e2530 field.
food.node_layout: Organize crop, livestock, cooking, and beverage/feast quests into four balanced orchard/kitchen plots across the quiet #0e2530 mid-field (x: -14.0 to +14.0, y: -2.0 to +7.0) above the bottom planter ledges.

engineering.title_placement: Compact original engineering.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: -7.0), ~12.0x6.7 quest units on the #1e1e28 field.
engineering.node_layout: Align primary Create/kinetic progression along a horizontal rail spine across y: +1.0 to +3.5 (x: -16.0 to +16.0), with short perpendicular sidings/spurs (y: -2.0 and y: +6.0) for contraptions, logistics, and steam/train upgrades above the bottom cobble/track bed.

magic.title_placement: Compact original magic.jpg centered at (x: 0.0, y: 0.0 or y: -6.5), ~12.0x6.7 quest units on the #0a090f field.
magic.node_layout: Place schools/traditions of magic in radial constellation lobes across the #0a090f central void so quest icons read like bright stars against the muted peripheral #141224-#251f42 pixel starfield.

native_icon_localized_title_chapters.route_policy: Use existing in-game item/effect icons and native localized FTB Quests chapter titles/subtitles. Do not generate substitute item icons or fake boss portraits.

Boss Busters.layout_direction: Bilateral trophy-hall gauntlet columns or tiered arena rings using each boss's authentic in-game spawn item, trophy, or drop icon and native localized title. Maintain >=2.5 quest units between boss encounters with zero invented dependency lines.

Power System.layout_direction: Clean bus-bar grid: generation sources on the left column, storage/transfer capacitors along a central horizontal bus, and machine consumers on the right column, using native block/item icons and localized headers.

Nightfall.layout_direction: Crescent dusk-to-midnight arc across the canvas using authentic nocturnal mob/event/equipment game icons and localized titles, spaced as independent night-watch stations.

Twelve Eyes.pattern: Twelve-Leaf Tournament Bracket / End Portal Convergence
Twelve Eyes.layout_direction: Symmetrical twelve-leaf tournament bracket (six authentic End Remastered eye icons on the left wing, six on the right wing) converging inward toward the central End Portal frame / Stronghold objective using only genuine in-game eye item icons and localized names without inventing prerequisite edges between independent eyes.
